scope: Independent mathematical/source review of four parent-authored trihedral, AE-stratum, conical-fiber, and actual-chart sources at successful checkpoint 5.

findings.details: Coordinate Riesz vectors are constructed from actual basis coordinate functionals and proved nonzero by evaluation at their own basis ray. Normalization gives actual unit inward conormals; orthogonality to the other two rays and positive own-ray orientation are proved, and these ordinary conditions characterize the unit conormal uniquely. The normalized coordinate duals are linearly independent. The actual nonnegative generated cone is proved equivalent to nonnegative basis coordinates and hence to outward halfspaces; its zero-coordinate facet is proved exactly the positive span of the other two rays. Neither normals nor incidence are supplied as desired conclusions.

Each affine exceptional threshold form has coefficient one at the coordinate outside the selected finite tuple, so it is a genuinely nonzero linear form independently of normal dependence. Chosen span coefficients depend only on fixed normals/indices, not thresholds. Evaluating their actual normal linear combination at an alleged common active point yields exactly the excluded affine threshold relation. Finite tuple/extra-index intersections give simultaneous volume-AE exclusion. The actual theorem is AE-only and does not itself assert arbitrary-threshold simplicity or complete stratification.

Actual cone-ball volume is computed by polar transport of the genuine hard set indicator, yielding epsilon^3/3 times actual spherical cone area. The fourth-radius fiber integrates over the actual cone intersected with its epsilon-ball. Compact-domain continuity supplies genuine integrability; actual output radius is at least R(base)/2, and the Gaussian shift lower bound uses norm(y)<=epsilon<=1 plus inner(z,y)<=R*epsilon<=1. Combining epsilon=1/(4R), the volume factor, and (R/2)^4 gives exact denominator 3072. The actual vector integral norm bound gives coefficient at most 2R*area, hence exact multiplier 6144*exp(3/2), with no edge count or minimum-angle constant.

The actual archived normalSectionChart at zero is bundled as a Euclidean linear isometry through explicit native/WithLp coordinate conversions. Additivity/scalar linearity come from actual Gaussian rotation and zero-coordinate insertion, while norm preservation follows from the exact chart norm-square identity. The inverse uses the actual inverse rotation and removeNth. On the selected unit supporting plane, the inverse-rotated normal coordinate is proved zero, and insertNth/removeNth reconstructs the original point. The final surjectivity-on-plane theorem is derived from that explicit inverse, not assumed.

qualifications: The affine no-extra-active-normal result is volume-almost-everywhere only. No arbitrary-threshold or irredundant-face reduction is inferred from it in this review.

Actual angle identification, full codimension-three Gaussian mass transport, normal-cone incidence in the complete manuscript geometry, and quantitative H.1 aggregation are separate application scopes.
Spherical area uses Euclidean-volume polar normalization, without asserting equality to raw diameter-normalized Hausdorff measure.
